content.scenario: A local cooperative society, Green Earth, purchases a bulk order of organic fertilizers from a company, EcoFriendly, for resale to its members. In this transaction, both Green Earth and EcoFriendly are considered persons under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, as they are a cooperative society and a company, respectively.
content.outcome: As persons, both Green Earth and EcoFriendly are subject to the provisions of the Act, including responsibilities and rights in consumer transactions.
